key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes QryG.

key.name: theme-preference
key.description: default follows the system, dark and light force one.

key.name: style
key.description: Name of a CSS file in ~/.config/qryg-search/styles, without .css. Empty uses the built-in look.

key.name: disabled-providers
key.description: Search sources that never show results, by provider id or desktop id. Manage with `qryg-search provider`.

key.name: plugin-settings
key.description: JSON object of settings for plugins, keyed by plugin id. Manage with `qryg-search plugin config`.

key.name: keywords
key.description: JSON object mapping plugin id to its prefix, overriding the plugin default. An empty string removes the prefix. Manage with `qryg-search keyword`.

key.name: plugins-reload
key.description: Changing this rescans the plugin folders. `qryg-search plugin reload` bumps it.

key.name: feature-keywords
key.description: Typing a plugin prefix searches only that plugin. Word prefixes like "f" need a space after them.

key.name: feature-row-actions
key.description: Buttons on the selected row: new window, open folder, copy.

key.name: feature-currency
key.description: Convert currencies with daily rates from open.er-api.com, cached locally.

key.name: feature-web-fallback
key.description: Always offer a web search as the last result.

key.name: feature-shell-preview
key.description: Run allowlisted read-only commands while typing after > and show their output.

key.name: currencies
key.description: Targets for an amount typed without "to", like "50 usd".

key.name: search-engine
key.description: URL for web searches, %s is replaced by the query.

key.name: web-shortcuts
key.description: key|Name|url entries. Typing "key query" searches that site.

key.name: terminal
key.description: Terminal for shell commands and command bookmarks. Empty picks the first installed.

key.name: shell-preview-commands
key.description: Commands that may run while typing. An entry matches the first words of the command. Previews run without a shell, capped at 2 seconds and 6000 characters, and never run anything containing shell syntax, globs, = or output options.

key.name: feature-top-hit
key.description: Lift the best match into its own Top Hit section.

key.name: feature-completion
key.description: Show the rest of the top hit's name after the cursor, Tab or Right accepts it.

key.name: feature-bar-icon
key.description: Replace the magnifier with the selected result's icon.

key.name: feature-preview
key.description: Show details for the selected result beside the list.

key.name: feature-filters
key.description: Apps, Files, Actions and Clipboard buttons with Super+1 to Super+4.

key.name: feature-remember-query
key.description: Reopen with the previous query selected.

key.name: feature-bounce
key.description: Open with a slight spring instead of a plain fade.

key.name: feature-file-search
key.description: Search files in the home folder through plocate and recently used files.

key.name: feature-clipboard
key.description: Search clipboard history from a supported clipboard manager.

key.name: feature-file-actions
key.description: Super+Enter shows the selected file in Files, Super+C copies its path.

key.name: feature-calculator-style
key.description: Show calculator and conversion answers as the row title.

key.name: width
key.description: Popup width in pixels.

key.name: top-offset
key.description: Distance of the bar from the top of the monitor, in percent.

key.name: max-rows
key.description: Maximum results shown in each section.

key.name: placeholder
key.description: Text shown in the empty search bar.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Color of the selected row, active filter and caret, as #rrggbb.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the results card. The search bar, rows and preview scale with it.

key.name: opacity
key.description: Opacity of the bar and card, in percent.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size of the search bar text in pixels.

key.name: exclude-paths
key.description: Path fragments whose files never show in file search.
